name: Sawbones
desc:
The unnamed sawbones is a Canor NPC. He serves as the chief medical office for [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority)'s garrison positioned in the Eastern Luminant.

In the modern day, the sawbones works alongside [Taiga](entity:taiga), handling medical emergencies while she handles more minor injuries. He has a reputation for amputation.

Despite this reputation, [Yakob](entity:yakob) considers paying a visit to him to be less unpleasant than the thought of marching through [The Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley) in full gear.
